quand: To the client, when the atelier cancels her appointment.
preheader: We need to move it. Please choose another time.

quand.description: The day and time of the appointment

blocs.texte:
Dear {prenom},

We will not be able to welcome you on {quand} for your appointment ({rendezvous}). Please accept our apologies. Choose another time, and it will be kept for you.

See you soon,
The Awrea Paris atelier
